entities.summary: Nathaniel Marvin Mason is an American professional basketball player for Dubai Basketball of the ABA League and the EuroLeague. He played college basketball for the Minnesota Golden Gophers. Mason attended High School at Arlington Country Day School in Jacksonville, Florida.
